subject: rooftop greenhouse and laundry
art_direction: 屋顶晾衣绳与小温室处在蓝色黄昏，远楼层次柔和，顶部天空留空。
visible_description: 屋顶晾衣绳与小温室处在蓝色黄昏，远楼层次柔和，顶部天空留空。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint a quiet rooftop at blue hour with a small glass greenhouse and two plain sheets hanging low on a laundry line. Warm light glows inside the greenhouse, illuminating leaves and a wooden stool. Keep the foreground parapet and plants detailed, with distant apartment blocks softened into layered silhouettes. Place all lines below the upper fifth so the dusk sky remains open and uncluttered. Vertical 1024x1536 for a phone wallpaper. Keep the upper 20% naturally quiet for the clock, with no lettering, logos, or watermark.
